name: Devyani International Ltd
title: Devyani International Ltd - 543330 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Devyani Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 10.4% YoY to INR 1,519 crore and operating EBITDA rose about 34% to INR 125 crore (pre-Ind AS).
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue grew 10.4% YoY to INR 1,519 crore, with KFC and international driving growth and Pizza Hut still declining. Operating EBITDA (pre-Ind AS) rose about 34% to INR 125 crore, margin 8.2% versus 6.8%, and the company posted Q2 PBT of INR 5.7 crore against a loss last year. Management flagged strong raw material, LPG and state minimum wage inflation, with only a small 1-2% YTD price increase so far. The Sapphire Foods merger received CCI approval; SEBI no-objection and NCLT approval remain pending, with closing targeted by fiscal year-end.

financial_highlights.metric: EBITDA (as stated in Chairman's remarks, likely Ind AS basis)

financial_highlights.change: vs loss of INR 24 crore last year
brand contribution INR 91 crore, margin 17.9%, +1.2 pp YoY

segments.name: KFC
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 642 crore (+12.3% YoY); SSSG 4.4%; gross margin 68.2% (flat); brand contribution margin 13.9% (flat); 50 net adds taking network to 844 stores; on-premise saliency 56%.

segments.name: Pizza Hut
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 184 crore (nearly flat YoY); SSSG -1.4% (decline narrowed QoQ); ADS INR 32,000 per store per day; gross margin 76.7%; brand contribution margin -1.8% (loss INR 3.3 crore); 632 stores after 6 net adds.

segments.name: Own Brands (Biryani By Kilo, Vaango)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 95 crore (+~11% YoY); BBK SSSG 8.1%, Vaango SSSG 6.9%; gross margin 65.4% vs 62.6%; brand contribution INR 9 crore (9.4%); 225 stores including 26 BBK Express.

segments.name: Franchisee brands (Costa)
segments.commentary: Franchise portfolio revenue grew about 7% YoY; Costa SSSG 9.9%, gross margin 74.2% (vs 73.6%), brand contribution margin 15.5%; 202 stores.

segments.name: International
segments.commentary: Revenue INR 509 crore with brand contribution INR 91 crore (17.9%); Thailand flooding in September disrupted business and fuel costs weighed on consumers.

guidance_outlook: Full-year net new store additions guided at 200-220; company says it is on track.
KFC standalone store additions guided at 100-110 for FY27; management says it will deliver.
Merged-entity guidance to be revisited after CCI approval; management will engage and come back.
Merger with Sapphire Foods targeted to close by end of current fiscal year (FY27), pending SEBI no-objection and NCLT approval.
Q3 SSSG targeted to be slightly better than Q2; Q2 SSSG levels described as sustainable.
Biryani By Kilo brand contribution target of about 14-15% in short to medium term.
capex_capacity: Store footprint at 1,923 in India and 2,325 globally as of September 30, 2026; 70 net adds in Q2 (68 in India).
Revamped business development structure now in place; management says it is firing and phasing of openings has been shifted between quarters without changing full-year numbers.
Pizza Hut to add stores selectively, replacing underperforming closures.
Own Brands network at 225 stores; BBK Express format being tested at food courts.
demand_pricing: SSSG across India brands ranged 4% to 9% (excluding Pizza Hut), with growth described as transaction-led and on-premise led.
Price hikes limited to 1-2% YTD, staggered to protect muted consumer sentiment; management says price increases still on the agenda.
KFC value architecture: INR 99 and INR 149 meal combos, Wednesday value offer, BOGO offers in select markets.

Q2 seasonality: Navratri moved into October (north and west skew) while Durga Puja shifted into the next quarter (south and east skew, where KFC is strong); management expects Q2+Q3 combined to be similar to peers.
North region KFC SSSG reported at +20%; management says on a regional basis it is in line with or slightly ahead of peers.
Competition and macro: food and fuel inflation, job losses from AI adoption cited as pressures on household budgets.

qa_highlights.question: Why has KFC lagged some peers sequentially, and what is October trending like?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed part of the gap to Navratri shifting into Q2 for peers, while Durga Puja (a KFC tailwind in south and east) shifted into Q3; expects Q2+Q3 to be similar to peers and targets Q3 SSSG slightly above Q2.

qa_highlights.question: Is Pizza Hut moving to a value-focused, transaction-led strategy post-merger?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the focus is innovation pipeline, entry-level price laddering and dine-in; value offers are tied to multiple price points, with rollout of similar BOGO-type offers over the next couple of quarters.

qa_highlights.question: Is inflation fully in the P&L or are there further headwinds?
qa_highlights.answer: Raw materials (chicken, oil, paper) are stabilising but not fully passed on; minimum wage hikes are fully baked in, with possible small additional state hikes; gas prices doubled YoY and are stable, with pricing the only variable.

qa_highlights.question: Will KFC gross margin fall further?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said current price increases are baked in and it does not expect gross margin to deteriorate further, though further price increases remain on the agenda and promotions are a lever.

qa_highlights.question: What drove Biryani By Kilo's turnaround and can it reach 20%+ margin?
qa_highlights.answer: Target is brand contribution of about 14-15% in the short to medium term, driven by procurement scale, store labour efficiency and supervisory layer efficiency, plus positive SSSG leverage.

qa_highlights.question: Can KFC SSSG for Q2+Q3 be 8-9% as Sapphire indicated?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to comment on Sapphire; said Q2 SSSG is sustainable and Q3 is targeted slightly better. North KFC SSSG was +20% to illustrate seasonality impact.

qa_highlights.question: Will KFC store additions slow given near-term headwinds and the merger?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said there is no reason to slow KFC expansion given under-penetration vs pizza and chicken demand; KFC guidance of 100-110 stores is unchanged, and phasing is being shifted ahead of post-merger reset.

qa_highlights.question: Will Pizza Hut's strategic plan be shared soon?
qa_highlights.answer: Not yet; management will share more colour once the merger is consummated, after understanding Sapphire's Pizza Hut granular performance.

risks_watch: Sustained raw material (chicken, oil, paper), LPG (nearly double YoY) and state minimum wage inflation versus the limited 1-2% price increase taken so far.
Pizza Hut SSSG still negative at -1.4% with negative brand contribution (-1.8%); turnaround plan not yet detailed.
Merger execution: pending SEBI no-objection and NCLT approval; management expects post-merger management reset and possible slowdown in store openings.
Heightened food-authority inspections disrupting store operations; consistency of enforcement uncertain.
Thailand flooding and higher fuel costs weighing on international demand; merged-entity guidance still to be issued.
Macro: management expects discretionary spending to stay under pressure as interest rates begin to rise.
summary.management_tone: Confident on operating execution and store expansion, but cautious on consumer demand and the near-term cost outlook. Management was evasive on peer comparisons and Sapphire's numbers and deferred Pizza Hut strategy and merged guidance to later.
key_quotes: This is one of the best Q2 operating EBITDA numbers that we have seen and the same helped us post profit before taxes of INR 5.7 crore for the quarter against a loss last year.
We are building the business for the future, we are not building for near term.

adds.what: Net new store additions FY27 guided at 200-220 across brands (70 net adds in Q2, 1,923 stores in India)
KFC standalone store additions 100-110 for FY27 (50 net adds in Q2 taking KFC to 844 stores)

growth.why: Management held FY27 guidance of 200-220 net new stores and 100-110 KFC additions (70 net adds in Q2, 50 KFC), with store count and SSSG of 4-9% backing growth, but no explicit revenue growth guidance and price hikes limited to 1-2% YTD.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Operating EBITDA margin rose to 8.2% from 6.8% and gross margin is up 70 bps to 68.5%, but raw material, LPG and minimum wage inflation is only partly passed on with 1-2% YTD price hikes, and management sees no further gross margin deterioration yet.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Net new store additions of 200-220 for FY27 are reaffirmed as on track after 70 net adds in Q2 (68 in India), and KFC is guided to 100-110 standalone additions with 50 done in Q2 and 844 stores now.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: SSSG across India brands runs 4% to 9% (ex Pizza Hut), KFC Q2 SSSG 4.4% is called sustainable, and Q3 SSSG is targeted slightly better than Q2, though Pizza Hut SSSG is still -1.4%.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management reaffirmed store guidance but gave no revenue or margin upgrade, and merged-entity guidance is still to be revisited after CCI approval with discretionary spend under pressure.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Management expects a post-merger management reset that could slow store openings, and Pizza Hut SSSG is -1.4% with brand contribution at -1.8%, while merged-entity guidance is still pending.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: BBK Express food-court format is being tested across 26 stores, and Pizza Hut plans BOGO-type value offers over the next couple of quarters, though no firm launch dates were given.

rows.label: Sapphire Foods merger closing
rows.why: CCI approval is received and management is optimistic about closing by fiscal year-end, but SEBI no-objection and NCLT approval are still pending.

rows.label: Biryani By Kilo margin to 14-15%
rows.why: BBK SSSG is 8.1% and brand contribution is 9.4% today against a 14-15% target, driven by procurement scale, store labour efficiency and positive SSSG leverage.

rows.label: Further price increases
rows.why: Only 1-2% YTD price hikes have been taken against raw material, LPG and minimum wage inflation, and management says further price increases remain on the agenda but are staggered to protect demand.

tone.note: Management was confident on store expansion (200-220 net adds reaffirmed) and Q2 SSSG sustainability, but cautious on consumer demand and cost pressure, and it was evasive on Sapphire's numbers and peer comparisons, deferring Pizza Hut strategy and merged guidance.
